evidence:
The source portion is consistent, but the full configured verifier launch/grading requirement has not been measured. Actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx was opened using openpyxl: Quality Checks!row 23 (number 22) requires a pinned browser, Playwright, judge CLI, rewardkit and app runtime; Internal Quality Checks!row 23 repeats that expectation without an added annotation. Deterministic Checks!row 32 explicitly excludes build-only tools from the runtime dependency parity requirement. The frozen Harbor quality-checks.md:96-98 additionally calls for Python for the restart server; staged-task-contract.md sections tests/test.sh and tests/<suite>/<dimension>/judge.toml define launch and MCP wiring. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md, Runtime and model evidence, requires hash-bound full verifier launch/grading evidence before local clearance; SKILL.md says never upgrade an unmeasured claim to Pass.

In .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/Dockerfile:1-4, Node 22 /usr/local is copied into the Python 3.12 image. Lines 16-21 install @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1. Line 31 pins harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7. Lines 33-38 install Chromium using the pinned MCP package's Playwright CLI and expose /usr/local/bin/chromium. Lines 43-45 copy /tests and configure its executable entrypoint. environment/Dockerfile:9-12 supplies the same two app runtime package versions; I checked both package.json dependency entries against both Dockerfiles. solution/app/server.js:2-5 imports only Node built-ins and those packages. solution/app/package.json:17-20 places TypeScript/Vite in devDependencies; environment/instructions/integration.md:11 requires compiled frontend files and no startup install. Thus their absence from the verifier is not a runtime defect.

All five parsed judge.toml files (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) at lines 11-12 invoke playwright-mcp with --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium. Functional lines 17-18 use /usr/local/bin/python3 with /tests/tools/restart_mcp.py. That server imports only Python standard-library modules (lines 4-7). tests/test.sh:104-111 passes NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules and invokes Node; :207-209 invokes rewardkit. Both candidate Dockerfiles are byte-for-byte equal to the frozen canonical template (tests SHA256 72998ab8ef0e4225e63b88fccdb754943c54022e25da355035efe7f759a55fdd; environment SHA256 0a75419e9598ded9317b26bbf0d2b12de0b9b11185fb4c9fed1ca7f3e52467d1). No task-specific missing dependency or demonstrated inherited image conflict was established.

I independently SHA256-checked raw qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-repair3/golden/run-golden-20260930-092021/RESULTS.json against raw-evidence-index.json: ec88c00c12336257196e209f427a40690b76b4d3fc7f283656bc67735cf1bc09 matches. Every actual_app_files entry matches the frozen golden and every recorded driver hash matches its saved copy. app.log:1 reports 'Colderwater ready on port 3000'; RESULTS named fields report Chromium Google Chrome for Testing 152.0.7977.8 and MCP Version 0.0.79. These observations support launch/browser availability. However drivers/launch_workflow.py:38 launches the app directly, :43 runs a scripted Node driver, and :69 directly runs the restart server. drivers/run_workflow.cjs:3 imports Playwright and :21 launches Chromium directly. Neither driver invokes RewardKit or the configured Claude judge; launch_workflow.py:97 explicitly records oracle_score_claimed=False. The raw evidence index itself states 'No full configured verifier, target model, Oracle or measured judge workload supplied.' This is partial runtime evidence, not proof that the frozen verifier image can complete configured grading. No new Docker/provider/network run was performed.
counterexample: Source-level adversarial checks, not executed mutations: a conforming solution can ship compiled browser assets while using only Express, better-sqlite3 and Node built-ins at server startup. Failing its image solely because TypeScript/Vite are absent would contradict Deterministic Checks!row 32 and integration.md:11. Conversely, an image whose Claude executable is unavailable, or whose RewardKit-to-judge invocation is incompatible, can still pass every supplied direct Playwright launch/browser flow because launch_workflow.py never calls that grading path. This plausible false-pass witness establishes the evidence gap, not an observed image defect.
suggested_fix: Measure one full configured verifier launch/grading run on these frozen bytes and record the image/build identity, exact command, input hashes, CLI/MCP logs and reward outputs; retain the canonical image and harness unless a concrete failure demonstrates a needed correction.
